name: Many comparable pairs in a fixed-size set family
description: construct() -> exactly forty distinct subsets of vertices 0..11, each as a list of distinct integers; the empty set is allowed. Maximize the number of unordered pairs in which one member is a strict subset of the other. The local parameters are n=12 and m=40. This is a finite lower-bound construction for c(12,40); the baseline consists of the first forty binary masks and does not copy the paper’s extremal constructions.
